reuse.why: Routes every amount site (server app, preview, forecast-free template, API list, UI) through the existing exported getScheduledAmount and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules for the tolerance.

duplication.why: The four inline null/number/midpoint copies are deleted in favour of the single helper; no new copies are introduced.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount; the API field is computed in the api handler and typed in api-models as the tree does for other API shapes.

scope.why: Edits serve the four steps; updating every UI caller for the new required amountOp argument and the docs entry is necessary churn, not unrelated.

maintainability.why: One function owns the whole expected-amount rule, though amountOp is typed as a bare string and useScheduleEdit passes literal ops ('is'/'isbetween') that a reader must reason about.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All amount resolution goes through getScheduledAmount; the approximate tolerance uses getApproxNumberThreshold.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic remains; the midpoint copies were removed, not reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains a required amountOp parameter and an isapprox branch inside it (the requested variation); every caller, including schedule-template, schedules app, preview and the API list, now uses it.
